articles.summary: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL), a global leader in advanced composites technology, will showcase new materials, qualification milestones and manufacturing innovations at the Composites and Advanced Materials Expo (CAMX) 2026 , Sept. 22-24 in Atlanta. Visitors to Hexcel's Booth P4 will learn how the company is helping customers accelerate the development and production of next-generation aircraft, strengthen defense and space capabilities, and benefit from the advantages of Hexcel’s vertically integrated composites supply chain. "CAMX provides an important opportunity to engage with customers, partners and industry leaders as the composites industry prepares for the next generation of aerospace platforms," said Lyndon Smith, President, Americas Global Fibers, Hexcel. articles.title: Hexcel to Showcase Advanced Composite Innovations for Aerospace, Defense and Space at CAMX 2026
